messages:
ravi: Hey all, first day on Platform. I never got an Okta invite (no mail in spam) and Google login says 'account pending'. 1Password onboarding link on the quickstart returns 403. Also need SSH access. Who do I ping?

it-ops-bot: Automation: No Okta activation record for ravi@redwood.dev. Please confirm email or open a ticket in #it-ops.

aria: Welcome @ravi! Confirming email and OS? We'll resend Okta and trigger Google provisioning.

ravi: ravi@redwood.dev, MacBook Air Ventura. No laptop imaging needed.

sam: Resent Okta activation to ravi@redwood.dev and queued Google sync job. Okta invite should arrive within a couple minutes.

it-ops-bot: System: Okta activation resent (job 122334). Google workspace sync queued.

ravi: Got Okta and set up password, but Okta SSO app in Chrome keeps redirecting back to sign-in (infinite loop). Firefox ok. Any tips?

aria: Try clearing site data for okta.redwood.com and disable any strict cookie blocking/extensions. Incognito can help quickly. Also check the 1Password extension — autofill has blocked SSO for some folks.

ravi: Incognito worked, thanks. 1Password browser link still 403 though.

security-bot: Note: if you see 403 it can be missing vault membership. @sam or @devex can add you to the team vault. Do not share secrets in channel.

sam: I added ravi to the platform vault minutes ago. For CLI, run:

```bash
# sign in to 1Password CLI
eval "$(op signin redwood)"
op vault list | grep platform
```
If you get errors paste sanitized output.

ravi: CLI signin succeeded and I can list the platform vault, browser UI still 403 but CLI is enough for now. Quick SSH question: where to add my public key? GitHub Enterprise or internal deploy manager?

devex: Add your SSH public key to your GitHub Enterprise profile for repo access and request org membership in #eng-setup. For service/deploy keys, file a ticket to eng-platform and we'll add them.

ravi: Added key to GH and requested org access. All good for now, appreciate the quick help! :tada:
